title: The Sneeze That Means It's True

collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — LUCK, OMENS AND LAVASTONES (LO-01 to LO-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A friend sneezes just as a villager promises to finish a new roof, and that means it must be true.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: "I'll have the new roof finished by the next full moon," says (subject). At that exact moment, (friend) sneezes. In (friend)'s family, a sneeze right after someone says something means it's true. (friend) looks at (subject) seriously. "Well, that settles it."

choices.label: Say It Was Just a Sneeze

a.name: Answer A
a.text: "You heard the sneeze," says (friend), every time (friend.he/she) passes (subject)'s half-finished roof. (subject) works harder than (subject.he/she) has in months. The roof is finished one day before the full moon. (friend) is triumphant. (subject) privately suspects the sneeze was faked, but doesn't dare ask.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: "It was just a sneeze," says (subject). "Sneezes don't mean anything." (friend) shrugs. The roof is finished a few days after the full moon. "See?" says (subject). "The sneeze was wrong." "Or," says (friend), "you didn't believe in it, so it didn't work." (subject) opens (subject.his/her) mouth, and then closes it. There's no winning that argument.
